claim: A parameterized physics-informed neural network with a learned latent space can improve the quality of convection-diffusion-reaction (CDR) solutions across thousands of equations.
falsifier: Train a parameterized physics-informed neural network with latent space on a set of CDR equations, then evaluate solution quality on held-out CDR equations; compare to non-parameterized baselines.

conditions: the evaluation covers thousands of CDR equations
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported CDR equations and the specific P2INN architecture; transfer to other PDE types is unestablished.

title: Using a parameterized architecture–quality of CDR solutions principle
